column3: “All of them” extends strong beyond the fourth chariot’s horses.
“The LORD” supplies the subject of said.
“The LORD” supplies the subject of the call.
“An offering” supplies the object of take; the final reference to those arriving from Babylon is moved next to the names.
“From His place” renders from beneath Him.
“Be clothed in splendor” replaces bear majesty.
“Crown” is singular instead of plural; the gracious son renders Hen, son.
